'''Soshiro Hori''' (Japanese: '''堀総士郎''' ''Hori Sōshirō'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Hori was born sometime on August 21 in {{wp|Hokkaido}}, {{wp|Japan}}. He became a voice actor as an adult and mostly got minor roles. He joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|SM}}, voicing [[Team Skull]] member [[Zipp]], his best-known role to date. Hori is currently affiliated with the talent agency {{wp|81 Produce}}.
